repo.description: Bring projects, wikis, and teams together with AI. AppFlowy is the AI collaborative workspace where you achieve more without losing control of your data. The leading open source Notion alternative.

release.name: v0.14.8
release.notes:
### 🚀 v0.14.8

#### New Features

- **Conditional formula styling** — Added colors, highlights, and text formatting through `style()` and `unstyle()` to highlight results based on formula conditions. Displayed the formatting in database cells and formula previews.
- **Simple table conversion** — Added actions to turn simple tables into databases or text, with undo and redo support.

#### Improvements

- **Cloud database loading** — Opened database views while rows loaded in the background and reused downloaded rows when reopening. Added automatic recovery notices while waiting for a busy server, plus clearer load errors with retry and error-copying actions.

#### Bug Fixes

- Fixed missing or stale database rows during loading and restore recovery, and preserved visible rows while a refresh was still loading.
- Fixed sidebar space selection when opening database rows from mention notifications or switching tabs, without redirecting to the space's default page.
- Fixed page duplication failures caused by delayed source synchronization or newly created database rows.
- Fixed simple-table alignment, undo and redo after deleting tables, and scrolling when adding rows to wide tables.

release.name: v14.0.0
release.notes:
GSYVideoPlayer **14.0.0**

本版覆盖 `v13.2.1..v14.0.0` 的全部 **27 条提交（含 2 条合并）**，完整更新说明与逐提交清单见下方链接。

- **IJK / FFmpeg**：`ex_so` 与独立 arm64 / armv7a / x64 使用 **FFmpeg n5.1.10 + OpenSSL 3.5.9**，FFmpeg/player/SDL 成套重编，补齐 MJPEG、HEVC seek/replay 和 FFmpeg 5 API 兼容修复。
- **TLS / HLS**：修复 ARMv7 HTTPS 证书加载崩溃；针对 NDK r22b / Clang 11 修正 OpenSSL 编译选项和缓存身份。嵌套 HLS 与 keepalive 重连保留显式证书、主机名校验和代理配置。
- **音频**：软件变速支持 **0.25×–4×**，平台倍速支持范围取决于设备；修复重采样、起播、变速引擎排空与切换、EOF 完成和终止错误状态。
- **RTSP / 会话**：支持初始化 OPTIONS / DESCRIBE / SETUP / 初次 PLAY 的重定向，透传 `timeout`（微秒）和传输配置；新增可选直播队列上限，隔离旧会话回调、已排队消息和看门狗。
- **Codec2**：保留原解码器选择，Android 10+ 在原选择为空时补充普通硬件 `c2.*` 解码器筛选，排除纯软件及安全/隧道模式必需解码器。
- **GL 管线与滤镜**：新增 FBO 多 pass、高斯模糊、降采样金字塔、Bloom、LUT 调色、保边美颜、Glitch、CRT 和老电视信号干扰；支持 `uTime` 与额外纹理生命周期，修正旧 shader 并移除多余 `glFinish`。
- **折叠屏 Demo**：新增 XML / Compose 的 FLAT、BOOK、TABLETOP 布局，处理铰链、旋转、全屏和姿态测试注入，Compose 可运行 Demo 增至 **25** 个。
- **Compose**：修复 #4259 宿主卸载时的资源释放和 #4261 轮询缓冲进度同步；新增动态显示比例 API，补齐 IJK/EXO 缓存切换、缓存命中及缓冲展示。
- **R8 / 工具链**：精简 Demo 和 FAQ 的 JNI/反射保留规则；Gradle **8.12**、AGP **8.9.1**、R8 **9.4.14**，新增 **13 个接入 skills**，CI 纳入会话与 Compose 回归。

**升级说明：** 默认整包与 `gsyvideoplayer-ex_so` 包含 `arm64-v8a` / `armeabi-v7a` / `x86_64` 三个 ABI。迁移后的独立 ABI 模块与整包使用相同编解码配置，按 ABI 和包体积选择；旧 `armeabi` / `x86` 仅按需通过独立模块提供，未升级到 FFmpeg 5。Compose、投屏与 AliPlayer 为可选模块，核心最低 API 23，投屏模块要求 API 26。

```gradle
implementation "io.github.carguo:gsyvideoplayer:14.0.0"
```

Maven Central 使用 `io.github.carguo`，GitHub Packages 使用 `com.shuyu`。2026-10-10 已核验 Maven Central 的全部 15 个模块 POM / AAR 可以公开下载。

**发布验证：** Debug/Release（含 R8）、48 项会话回归、36 次单测执行（18 个独立用例 × 两种构建）、双渠道本地发布和三 ABI 静态/打包检查通过。原受影响的 Redmi M2104K10AC / API 33 上，最终 ARMv7 与 ARM64 各通过独立 CA 加载及 15 项 GSY/JNI 播放检查，覆盖 HTTPS、嵌套 HLS 错误 CA/SAN 拒绝、RTSP 初始化重定向、seek/完成、倍速和重采样。

当前 x86_64 与 16 KiB 页设备运行、硬解画面及新库完整声学回归仍未覆盖；当前设备检查使用静音输出且不设置视频 Surface。注入姿态矩阵不替代实体折叠屏传感器验收，历史旧库证据不替代最终发布库的验证。

## For regular users

Install `arm64-v8a` from the **Assets** section below. If it fails to install, use `Parallel.A`.

`Parallel` builds install side-by-side with the main APK, allowing you to use different settings and profiles (via the `AnkiDroid directory` advanced setting and a different AnkiWeb login).


## For testers

The builds with `full`, `play` and `amazon` are useful for testing our builds for different app stores:

- **`full`**: F-Droid & GitHub `Parallel` apks
- **`play`**: Google Play - does not have `MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE` permission as it is forbidden by Google, on uninstall the user is invited to delete data.
- **`amazon`**: Amazon - currently same as full, historically removed `CAMERA` permission


## ABI variants

We perform ABI splits to reduce APK size. In rare cases, a phone may not be using the `arm64-v8a` ABI. You can find your phone's ABI using [kamgurgul/cpu-info](https://github.com/kamgurgul/cpu-info). If disk space isn't an issue, use the `full` apk.

# What's Changed

## Python 3.14 with CURL-CFFI built-in

Now on github and f-droid flavours of the app, python 3.14 is preinstalled within the app, which also includes curl-cffi and other new recommended yt-dlp libraries:
- brotli
- requests
- websockets
- urllib

For people who are not aware, YTDLnis has a plugin system where you can upgrade packages like python,ffmpeg, nodejs,deno etc without needing to update the app itself. You can update on your own too in the updating section, packages.
Note. Curl cffi is only released on arm64, but the rest can just take advantage of the new python and the new libraries. When curl-cffi is built for other arch, expect a new release of python in packages section in the settings.

## BGUtils POT Provider

Now in Advanced settings, Generate PO Tokens you can internally host the BGUtils POT server so that yt-dlp can use to generate PO Tokens for its youtube downloads. You are required to install the Deno package to install the node modules and host the server. If you want to use the provider as a script instead of server, install the NodeJS package. At the moment you can't use NodeJS install node_modules and host the server, just use NodeJS after you set it up with Deno as a generation script provider.

When used as a server, the server will automatically start when a download starts and close itself when the download queue finishes. If you feel the need to keep the server running, you can toggle BGUtils on in the settings and it will start the server.

## Reworked Terminal

This has been long overdue. 
Now Terminal is a full fledged terminal, taking use of termux's terminal-view. App uses android's default shell and all libraries like python ffmpeg etc, that the app uses can be easily executed there.
Since the new python 3.14 also has pip installed, you can easily execute pip to install and update yt-dlp plugins within the app.

Dashbeam now works with phones running Android 12 and older, you can mark a device as trusted so its files arrive without a prompt, and the mobile UI has had a round of fixes.

## Highlights

### Trusted devices

Mark a device you own as trusted and its transfers land automatically, with no accept prompt and no waiting by the screen. Incoming files are sorted into a folder named after the device that sent them, so you can tell at a glance where something came from.

- Auto-accept is now a clearly labelled switch in pairing settings
- Unattended receives raise a notification so you know something arrived
- Trusting a device, or removing one, asks for confirmation first
- Trusted invites are queued rather than accepted inline, and the whole queue drains at once

### Support for Android 12 and older

Sending now works on Android 12 and below. If Dashbeam previously failed to send from an older phone, it should just work.

### Android UI and UX

- Settings and History pages are padded correctly for the system bars
- The send-to-device sheet fits the phone screen instead of overflowing
- Settings sidebar rows are tappable on mobile

- The main activity is no longer declared non-resizeable, so split screen and foldables behave
- Update checks now run on Android release builds, and diagnostics export works again

Builds also changed on the Android side: there's a Play Store AAB build with its own CI workflow, and a separate workflow for developer-verification APKs.

App Manager can now block internet for individual applications utilizing the eBPF rules in root or ADB mode. To block internet for an application, go to the "Uses permissions" tab and click on the toggle button next to `android.permission.INTERNET` to revoke the permission.
  
_Known Limitation._ The eBPF rules are lost after a reboot. App Manager attempts to restore the rules right after a reboot. Public preview for compatible BYD Android head units. Android 7.1+ (API 25) remains the minimum; Android 7.1–8.1 still needs vehicle testing. This update focuses on wired USB stability, Wi-Fi Direct stutter, voice notes in messaging apps and update notices. USB and wireless remain available, subject to the head unit's firmware and hardware.

## Highlights

- Wired CarPlay no longer reconnects when the head unit delivers one damaged USB network block, which dropped sessions 1–2 s after the picture appeared on several head units. Older iPhones get a second identification attempt, and USB auto-confirm recognizes the Android 10+ and Chinese permission prompts. Related: [#565](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/issues/565), [#558](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/issues/558), [#556](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/issues/556), [#409](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/issues/409). [#575](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/pull/575)
- New **Settings → Connection → USB connection → iPhone charging** for cars whose USB port may not supply the iPhone's charging current. Reduced (1.5 A) or Low (0.5 A) replace the Normal 2.4 A offer. Related: [#514](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/issues/514). [#583](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/pull/583)
- Voice notes in apps such as WhatsApp now record the head unit's microphone and no longer sound slurred. [#548](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/pull/548), [#547](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/pull/547)
- Smoother Wi-Fi Direct: Settings recommends the built-in car hotspot, and with approved network ADB, DiPlay pauses the car's Wi-Fi network search during Wi-Fi Direct on Android 7.1 and later. [#570](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/pull/570)
- DiPlay checks for a new release once a day and shows "Update available" on Home. The check can be turned off in About. [#488](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/pull/488)

release.name: v1.0.1765
release.notes:
### Added

- **Firewall management** for ufw and firewalld: view and edit rules and zones, with checks that warn before a change would lock you out of SSH.
- **Program status in the terminal:** progress (OSC 9;4), command start and finish (OSC 133) and program status (OSC 7501) are shown on the session, with an optional notification when a long command finishes.
- **Terminal line height** setting; the terminal settings show which font is in use.
- **Network traffic** beside speed on the server page, with every interface selectable; the CPU row shows the thread count and per-thread usage.
- A per-server option to count network filesystems in the disk total.

### Changed

- **Every narrow tab has the same top bar**, and bars stay clear of the iPadOS window controls.
- **Server rows in every side list look the same** (server, terminal, files, remote desktop): the distribution icon with a status dot, or a status bar when the icon is hidden.
- Home page charts appear faster.
- Disks are read from both lsblk and df, so the disk list and disk total match on every page.
- Memory in use no longer counts the page cache.
- ARM CPUs are named by implementer and part, and every core type is listed.

### Fixed

- The app failed to open in Italian, Korean and Azerbaijani.
- A terminal opened at launch failed when the server refused the first connection; it now retries.
- A terminal restored on another tab took the focus and the keyboard.
- Stopping the Agent now ends a running command at once.
- Agent replies and their code can be selected on every platform.
- Remote desktop: keyboard input, long press and VNC passwords.
- Themes are included in backups.
- A charged battery is no longer reported as an alert; a low battery on its own power is.
- A host without /etc/hostname now shows a name.

release.name: Operit AI V1.12.2
release.notes:
本次更新重点围绕模型兼容性、工具调用、聊天稳定性和数据管理展开，同时补充 ToolPkg、统计、恢复与性能监控能力。

## 增加

- 新增 Token 用量账本、统计看板、活动视图、价格覆盖、缓存命中率、生成速度和安全删除能力
- 新增独立 TTS/STT 服务档案，支持创建、复制、切换、删除和旧配置迁移
- 新增按窗口或指定日期范围重建聊天记忆
- Compose DSL 文件选择器新增文档、图片、视频、媒体、目录和相机模式
- 新增 `AiChat`、`AdaptiveSidePanel`、Compose DSL 对话框和聊天消息长按菜单
- 新增 DeepSeek Harness 运行时侧栏和完整 ToolPkg 运行时支持
- 新增 MiniMax、OpenCode Zen/Go、xAI Grok 和 OpenAI Codex OAuth 提供商，并支持 Codex 配额查询和 PDF 输入
- 新增按提供商和模型动态配置思考深度，补充 DeepSeek Responses、Qwen、Gemini 等端点规则
- 新增 DeepSeek Responses Web Search、服务端工具记录和 reasoning 回放
- ToolPkg 新增版本化 API、包依赖、加载顺序、运行态 Hook、消息持久化 Hook 和聊天消息菜单
- 新增数据库、DataStore 配置健康检查和手动修复流程，并在修复前归档原始文件
- 新增主进程、插件 QuickJS、终端和设备 CPU/内存/网络性能监控
- 新增日语本地化、xAI 绘图自定义 API 地址、ToolPkg Logo 和已选聊天记录导出

## 修复

- 修复并行或分段工具结果在流式展示、历史记录和下一轮请求中的顺序不一致问题
- 修复 Claude、DeepSeek、Gemini、Kimi、OpenAI 等 Provider 的工具调用与结果配对问题
- 修复未匹配工具结果被误报为“用户取消”，并补充缺失结果的诊断信息
- 修复 DeepSeek Responses commentary/reasoning 回放、工具历史和正文流式输出问题
- 修复 OpenAI Responses 中 `video_url`/`input_video` 内容丢失问题
- 修复长工具结果、超大聊天导出、被中断的流式回复和多工具结果被提前丢弃的问题
- 修复群聊编排重复发送用户消息，以及消息变体事件使用旧快照的问题
- 修复 Compose DSL 文本框光标跳动、复制预览回弹、输入法遮挡和 Markdown 表格链接点击问题
- 修复 MCP 工具发现成功后未及时注册，以及并发权限描述注册的数据竞争
- 修复媒体能力测试把“已连通”误判为“能力已验证”的问题
- 修复浏览器桌面 viewport、截图尺寸、Provider 历史图片和模型列表刷新问题
- 修复悬浮窗非法尺寸、初始化竞态和连续崩溃保护问题
- 修复 Web Chat JavaScript 模块 MIME 类型错误
- 修复备份恢复、SQLite 参数数量限制、偏好迁移和 ToolPkg manifest 解析问题
- 修复 OpenCode、Codex、DeepSeek 和 OpenAI 的思考参数映射与历史兼容问题

## 优化

- ToolPkg 发布、API 版本展示、依赖检查、包排序、manifest 选择和隐藏目录排除更加可靠
- 摘要支持分区配置、独立标题、启用状态和对话回顾设置
- Token 统计的迁移、恢复、重试、价格计算和长时间运行稳定性得到提升
- 状态卡片改用内置完整 Material Symbols 字体，离线环境下也能正常显示
- APK 逆向工具升级至 1.1.0，JADX 支持隔离进程、串行任务和更完整的错误诊断
- 改进聊天复制、长历史浏览、流式滚动、LaTeX 渲染和大消息处理
- CI 拆分 Android/JVM 检查并优化缓存、原生依赖和 Nightly 构建流程
- 市场贡献者内容、Logo、包来源、版本信息和审核流程更加完整
- README 默认切换为英文，并保留 `README.zh-CN.md` 中文版本
- 补充日语及多种语言的模型、市场、ToolPkg、统计和设置文案

感谢所有参与本版本开发、审查、测试、文档和本地化工作的贡献者。特别感谢 @AAswordman、@luojiaping、@CATMIAOZHI、@3316891527、@yoruuuchan、@YunXi-Aurora、@tuxKOH、@AikingChoice、@AnxForever、@nailuoGG 和 @okker24。

release.notes:
## Bitchat Android 2.0.1

### Highlights

- **Bitchat for Wear OS:** join the nearby mesh from your watch, use public chat and encrypted direct messages, browse People, manage favorites and verification, receive notifications, record voice notes, and receive images and files.
- **New chat styles:** choose the classic Matrix layout or peer-colored message bubbles, including bubble-aware media, timestamps, and delivery indicators.
- **Live push-to-talk:** stream voice in public channels and encrypted direct messages on Android and Wear OS, with improved recording feedback, waveforms, haptics, and slide-to-cancel controls.
- **Cashu support:** recognize and preview Cashu eCash tokens, use `/pay`, and redeem with a compatible external wallet or web flow. Cashu tokens are bearer instruments; anyone who obtains a token may be able to redeem it.
- **Persistent private conversations:** keep conversation history, unread state, aliases, favorites, and previews across restarts, with clearer controls for deleting conversations.
- **Offline geohash globe:** explore geohash channels with a native animated 3D globe, country borders, cities, polar coverage, and adjustable render quality.
- **Language picker:** change the app language from within Bitchat, with expanded translations.
- **Local-first APK sharing and updates:** share an installed APK nearby and resume signature-verified update downloads with clearer progress and rate-limit handling.
- **Reliability and privacy:** stronger queued-message delivery and ordering, Noise session recovery and identity binding, more reliable receipts and peer lifecycle handling, safer Wi-Fi Direct cleanup, bounded payload processing, quieter sensitive logging, and a more complete panic wipe of in-memory networking state.

### First reproducible full-app release

This is Bitchat Android's first reproducible full-app release. The unsigned phone and Wear OS APKs and Android App Bundles were built twice in independent GitHub Action

release.name: v1.7 — 支持 WhatsApp，分析结果改为常驻卡片
release.notes:
**新增**
- 支持 WhatsApp 一对一聊天（测试中）：读取聊天、判断、候选回复、填入整条链路。群聊不读；WhatsApp 里不截屏。读取规则来自 @smgonthebeat（#73）。
- 分析结果改成一张常驻小卡片：收起时只显示风险等级和对方意图，点标题展开看完整分析和候选回复，再点收起。卡片可以拖到屏幕任意位置，每个 App 分别记住位置。
- 候选回复下方新增「换一组」：判断不变，只重新生成一组候选，不会和上一组重复。
- 设置里可以选候选回复条数（1 / 2 / 3 条）；只要 1 条时不做排序，出得更快。
- 判断接口新增「Vercel」「OpenCode Zen」两个预设。

**改进**
- 只有对方发来新消息才重新分析。上下翻聊天记录不会清空卡片、不会重新分析，也不会弹来弹去；更新时旧结果先留着，标题旁显示已等待的秒数。
- 候选回复的语言跟随对方：对方说英文就用英文回复。
- 判断和回复各自最多等 30 秒，超时就停下并给出「重试」。
- 无障碍服务的注册名称改为 Jev 自己的名称。
- 截屏识别更流畅（感谢 @ahxoeh）；兼容更多中转网关（感谢 @xuancanhit99）。

**修复**
- 候选回复偶尔一直显示「生成中」。
- QQ 群聊上下滚动时分析面板卡成空白。

**已知限制**
- 从 v1.4 或更早版本升级后，需要到系统设置里重新打开一次 Jev 助手的无障碍开关。
- 隐藏界面内容或禁止截屏的 App 不支持；界面目前只有中文。
- 在第三方聊天 App 里使用可能不符合其用户协议，账号有被限制的风险，请自行判断。

**安装**
- 下载下方附件 `jev-assistant-v1.7-release.apk`，Android 11 及以上，arm64 机型。装过旧版的可以直接覆盖安装，设置和密钥都会保留。
- 完整更新记录见 [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/jev-chat/jev-chat-jarvis/blob/main/cn/CHANGELOG.md)。

# ArchiveTune v15.1.0

ArchiveTune **15.1.0** focuses on improving YouTube playback reliability, account synchronization, library management, podcasts, Android Auto, the immersive player, Home discovery, and overall application stability.

This release integrates **YouTube Music community content**, **featured playlist cards**, **podcast library management**, **podcast episode search**, **Android Auto support**, **automatic updates**, **Canvas backdrop capture**, improved **local-media reconciliation**, **Last.fm authentication**, and expanded **Browse** functionality.

It also includes improvements to Always-On Display handling, playback error reporting, account sessions, library refresh behavior, JavaScript runtime stability, and the immersive player experience.

---

## ✨ Highlights

### ⚡ YouTube Playback & JavaScript Runtime

The YouTube playback system continues to receive reliability and stability improvements.

- Integrated an updated YouTube JavaScript runtime bundle.
- Improved YouTube playback error mapping for `YoutubeiException`.
- Improved account session synchronization.
- Improved authentication-state handling during playback and library synchronization.
- Hardened JavaScript worker execution to prevent crashes from recursive array conversions and thread stack exhaustion.
- Simplified playback error handling and authentication checks.
- Improved handling of restricted authentication data during stream resolution.

**Contributors:** @rukamori, @mikooochi

---

### 🏠 Home & Community

The Home screen now includes more content discovery options.

- Integrated **featured playlist cards** into Home.
- Integrated the **Community** section into the Home feed.
- Integrated community playlist extraction and preview loading.
- Added filtering and loading support for community content.
- Improved organization of similar and personalized recommendations.
- Improved Home state handling and concurrency.

**Contributor:** @ruk

- **Page zoom** — the percent locks the layout viewport, so text, layout, images, and canvas scale together. A page's own viewport meta cannot pin the scale back to 100%. GeckoView applies the same script when the page finishes loading. Export again (#1266, closes #1264)

## Published packages

| Package | Version |
| --- | --- |
| [easy_refresh](https://pub.dev/packages/easy_refresh/versions/4.0.0) | 4.0.0 |
| [easy_paging](https://pub.dev/packages/easy_paging/versions/4.0.0) | 4.0.0 |

release.name: ReadAny v1.3.6
release.notes:
ReadAny v1.3.6 来啦。这一版重点完善了 **桌面端与移动端的 RAG / 知识检索能力**，新增 **PDF 深色与 Sepia 主题适配**，并集中改善 AI 对话、引用跳转、移动端输入以及 EPUB / PDF 阅读体验。

> 说明：本版本说明只列用户可感知的新增、优化和修复。开发过程中的内部验证、联调和边界问题收敛不单独列出。

## 新功能

- **PDF 支持深色与 Sepia 主题**：桌面端和移动端的 PDF 页面可跟随全局主题，并逐页识别内容，尽量避免对照片或深色页面错误反色
- **新增 Atlas Cloud AI 服务商**：可在 AI 模型设置中配置和使用 Atlas Cloud
- **AI 对话显示选中文本原句**：从阅读器选中文字并进入 AI 对话后，可在顶部直接对照原文提问
- **移动端补全本地与远程向量检索**：支持远程 Embedding，并为中文和英文提供本地模型选择

## 优化

- **RAG 检索更完整可靠**：统一桌面端和移动端的查询向量配置，校验书籍向量来源与维度，减少模型或服务切换后检索结果异常
- **AI 工具调用与引用跳转更稳定**：工具参数兼容性、超时处理和状态展示更可靠；缺少精确位置的引用也会尝试根据章节和原文恢复跳转
- **AI 对话反馈更清楚**：超长输入会提示分段提问，输出达到长度限制或工具调用未完成时不再把残缺回答显示为正常完成
- **移动端输入体验更完善**：设置、首次引导、笔记、书籍详情、新建分组等输入区域会自动避让键盘
- **阅读器书籍样式兼容性更好**：书籍字体设置可正确作用于正文，同时尊重书籍对行内图片高度的显式设置，并继续限制大图溢出
- **阅读器交互更稳**：优化 iOS 长按选词、划线和翻页的冲突，链接点击、目录跳转与正常点按翻页之间的判断更准确

## 修复

- 修复 iOS 选词或划线结束后可能误触翻页，以及选中状态下翻页行为不稳定的问题
- 修复点击 EPUB 目录或正文链接后可能闪回原页、跳到上一章的问题
- 修复部分 EPUB 缺少样式表链接时书籍样式完全丢失的问题
- 修复部分 EPUB 行内小图标被异常放大，以及行内标记式注脚无法预览或跳转的问题
- 修复 macOS Retina 屏幕上 PDF 文本层错位、跨行选中和复制不准确的问题
- 修复移动端 PDF 在深色主题下出现色差、白边等显示问题
- 修复 AI 聊天中超长连续文本无法换行、深色模式下 Markdown 可读性较差的问题
- 修复部分 AI 工具参数无法生成 Schema、引用未登记或点击后无法跳转的问题
- 修复 Android TTS 音色选择器崩溃，以及小米 MiMo TTS 偶尔无法继续朗读的问题
- 修复卸载外部 AI / CLI 接入后残留配置或反馈不明确的问题

---

## English Release Notes

ReadAny v1.3.6 improves **RAG and knowledge retrieval across desktop and mobile**, adds **dark and Sepia themes for PDFs**, and delivers a focused set of improvements to AI chat, citation navigation, mobile input, and EPUB / PDF reading.

> Note: these release notes only list user-facing additions, improvements, and fixes. Internal validation, integration, and edge-case cleanup are not listed separately.

## New Features

- **Added dark and Sepia themes for PDFs** on desktop and mobile, with per-page content detection to avoid incorrectly inverting photo-heavy or already-dark pages
- **Added the Atlas Cloud AI provider** to AI model settings
- **Added selected-text context to AI chat** so the original passag

Hi there everybody 👋

It's been some time since the last update, three months to be precise (god, time passes quickly). I've been collecting various features and improvements to the app. And today's the day I'll be releasing them all into the wild.

As always, if you stumble across any errors or inconsistencies, or you have an idea for a feature, feel free to open a new [issue report](https://github.com/JHubi1/ollama-app/issues/new/choose). Have fun.

~ Jakob

Thanks to many users on Crowdin, I'm happy to announce that Ollama App will be available in three new languages:

- Chinese (Simplified), thanks to Ruifeng and Pinkman Zhang
- Italian, thanks to Intranox
- Turkish, thanks to ShLerP

If you'd like to see your language added as well, help to localize the project. Read more in the [Contribution Guide](https://github.com/JHubi1/ollama-app/wiki/Contributing#translations).

## Added features

- Ability to add models
  - You remember seeing the message that adding models in the app is not supported? That's a thing of the past, in the latest version of Ollama App, you'll be able to download your favorite model directly from within the app
- Timeout multiplier
  - Were you ever in the situation that a request for a message fails because of your slow internet connection or because your host is too slow? Timeout multiplier is the solution. It'll multiply every timeout value in the app, so those situations can be prevented

repo.description: NipaPlay-Reload 是一个现代化的跨平台本地视频播放器，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android 和 iOS。集成了弹幕显示、多格式字幕支持、多音频轨道切换，新番查看等功能，支持挂载Emby/Jellyfin媒体库。采用 Flutter +rust开发，提供统一的用户体验。

release.name: Release v1.11.9
release.notes:
## 新功能

**外挂字幕编辑框与多字幕交互** ([#933](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/933))

播放界面支持多条外挂字幕同时加载，各字幕拥有独立时间轴。长按字幕文字可弹出编辑框，拖动编辑框可同步调整全局字幕位置偏移。切换视频或跳转到下一句台词时编辑框自动收起，避免弹幕层因编辑框持续重绘而出现闪烁。字幕轨道菜单和字幕设置菜单同步提供 Cupertino 与 NipaPlay 两套主题样式。关联：[#920](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/issues/920)、[#922](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/issues/922)

**VobSub (.sub+.idx) 图形字幕支持** ([#957](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/957))

新增对 VobSub 图形字幕格式的完整支持，包括本地文件选择器、WebDAV/SMB 等远程来源及自动配对下载。加载视频时自动优先选择简体中文或日语字幕轨道，其余候选字幕堆叠在轨道菜单中供手动切换，切换时不会打断当前正在播放的字幕。远程缓存的字幕文件始终以原始文件名显示，冷启动后也能正确还原。

**播放器快捷调节与媒体库 NEW 标识开关** ([#945](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/945))

在"设置 → 播放器"新增"播放器菜单快捷调节"开关，开启后可在播放器菜单顶部直接调整倍速和音量增强，默认关闭。在"设置 → 外观"新增"媒体库 NEW 标识"开关，关闭后隐藏桌面、手机和电视媒体库卡片上的 NEW 角标，新内容追踪与排序逻辑不受影响，默认开启。两项设置重启后均保持选择。

**首页新番回顾板块** ([#953](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/953))

首页新增限时开启的新番回顾板块，可在设置中关闭。

**Linux 平台启用 Erika 播放内核** ([#972](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/972))

Linux 源码构建现在支持使用 Erika 原生播放内核。Wayland 环境下视频、字幕和弹幕通过原生视图渲染，Flutter 控件以透明层叠加；X11 使用兼容纹理视图。新安装默认使用 Erika，已保存的内核选择不受影响。源码构建安装器支持 `NIPAPLAY_WSL_GPU_COPY=1` 选项，可在 WSL 环境下启用 D3D12 GPU 帧直传，减少解码帧在 GPU 与 CPU 之间的往返传输。

**升级 Erika 至 0.2.1，Linux 发布包内置 Erika** ([#982](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/982))

将 Erika 播放引擎升级至 0.2.1，Linux 正式发布包现在随包携带 Erika 内核，新安装默认启用，已有用户的内核选择保留。amd64 和 arm64 均静态链接 FFmpeg 8，并启用 NVDEC、VA-API 和 Vulkan 互操作。

**媒体信息页剧集多版本绑定** ([#971](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/971))

新版媒体信息页支持将同一剧集绑定多个视频文件版本，播放前弹窗供用户选择对应版本，也可快速解除匹配。同时新增剧集自动定位，修复鼠标滚轮在剧集列表中滚动速度过慢的问题。

**Jellyfin 剧集添加日期排序** ([#979](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/979))

新增 Jellyfin 的"剧集添加日期"排序选项，使近期新增剧集的番剧可以排在前面，支持升序和降序。同时修复 Emby/Jellyfin 旧排序存档字段缺失时打开排序菜单或加载媒体库触发空值异常的问题。关联：[#795](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/issues/795)

## OpenClaw Android v2026.9.14

Standalone Android app, no Termux required.

> **If setup failed for you on a recent version, please try again.** The previously published APKs were missing one of `proot`'s required libraries, so setup could not complete at all on a fresh install. That is fixed in this release.

### Setup was broken, and is fixed

`proot` declares `Depends: libandroid-shmem, libtalloc`, but the script that bundles the proot binaries into the APK only fetched `libtalloc`. Every published APK therefore shipped a `proot` binary the Android dynamic linker refused to load:

```
CANNOT LINK EXECUTABLE ... library "libandroid-shmem.so" not found
```

Nothing downstream could run: no rootfs configuration, no Node.js, no OpenClaw. CI now **fails** rather than publishing an APK with incomplete proot libraries.

release.notes:
## What's new in Kiosk Satellite 2026.10.22

This release lets a Home Assistant motion sensor take the camera's place for waking the screen, and sends Android broadcasts so apps like Tasker can react to voice, intercom, alarms and the screensaver. Kiosks behind a reverse proxy can now be opened by name from Switch kiosk, and plugins get a secret setting type. It also moves the kiosk menu and settings up to the top of the screen on Lenovo's Android 15 tablets.

### Improvements

- **Use a Home Assistant motion sensor in place of the camera.** A new **External Motion Sensor** group under **Settings > Screensaver > Motion Detection** has a **Use Home Assistant entity** switch that reveals **Motion sensor entity**, which lists occupancy, motion and presence binary sensors. With it on, the sensor drives **Dismiss on motion**, **Only when screen is off** and **Postpone screensaver on motion**, and the camera no longer runs for them, so a tablet whose camera does not work, or has none, can still wake when someone walks up and stay on while they are around. The sensor turning on dismisses the screensaver. Staying on postpones it but never dismisses one that started with the sensor already on. Once it clears, the idle timeout and **Turn screen off after** take over as usual. The row shows whether the sensor reads Detected or Clear. The **Motion** entity, face detection and the Show fingers gesture keep using the camera. Both settings stay per device in new fleet profiles.
- **Android broadcasts for voice, intercom, alarms and the screensaver.** Kiosk Satellite now sends a broadcast when a Voice Satellite interaction starts, listens, thinks, speaks, announces and ends, when a timer changes, when an intercom call rings, connects or ends, when an alarm changes or rings and when the screensaver starts or stops. release.name: v1.0.0
release.notes:
## What's Changed

From open-source experiment to mature tool: Sossoldi officially reaches Version 1.0! 🚀

When you manage your personal finances, you aren't just tracking numbers. You are building awareness. For an open-source application, reaching v1.0 means one thing above all else: trust.

Over the past few months, we chose not to chase flashy features, but to do the heavy lifting instead. We rebuilt the foundations to ensure that every calculation is accurate, every piece of data is secure, and the daily experience is smooth.

What Sossoldi v1.0 brings:
• Data architecture and security: We redesigned database management so that modifying or deleting categories and accounts always happens in complete safety, without risking the integrity of your past budget or transaction history.
• A faster user experience: We streamlined daily tracking by introducing shortcuts for frequent accounts and categories, along with revamped settings management.
• The big return to iOS: iOS users receive a double update that catches up on all the work from v0.3.2 alongside v1.0 (subcategories, drag-and-drop reordering, and the Face ID fix).

Version 1.0 is not the finish line, but our official starting line. It is the solid foundation we needed before dedicating ourselves to the next major evolution of the app.

A huge thank you to everyone in the community who contributed code, bug reports, and ideas to make this milestone possible.

repo.description: VeneraNext 是一个跨平台漫画阅读器，支持本地漫画、WebDAV 漫画源、第三方网络漫画源，支持 Android、iOS、Windows、Linux、macOS 平台。

release.name: v1.17.0
release.notes:
本次正式版新增自动阅读、自动选择阅读模式、条漫左右边距、定时同步与多源仓库管理，完善 PDF 后台导入和离线阅读，并为 Linux x64／ARM64 增加 RPM、AppImage 分发格式。

### 新增

- 自动阅读覆盖全部七种阅读模式：分页按秒翻页，连续与瀑布流可选择平滑滚动或步进滚动，支持自动跨章及单本／设备设置。长按操作可选择放大图片、开始／停止自动阅读或无操作，并继承旧版长按缩放设置。
- 阅读器可按漫画原图比例自动选择页漫或条漫模式，默认关闭；单本手动设置优先，切换时保留章节与源图片位置。纵向连续与瀑布流新增左右边距，每侧支持 0%–30%，沿用全局／设备／单本设置，宽度限制同步遵循对应设置范围（#82）。
- 数据同步新增定时模式，可选 5／15／30／60／180／360 分钟，默认 30 分钟；合并本地修改，无修改时检查远端版本，保存待上传状态并在启动或恢复前台时补做到期同步，失败后按间隔重试。手动模式不再自动传输，所有模式均保留立即上传／下载。
- 漫画源统一通过“添加来源”导入链接、粘贴内容或 JS／JSON 文件，按内容识别并预览脚本与来源列表，支持选择安装、保存在线仓库、管理多个仓库及来源关联。安装队列支持并发下载、取消、重试和进度查看。
- PDF 导入独立于进度框运行，收起进度或返回后可继续阅读；主页及本地漫画页提供任务入口，可重新查看进度、取消排队／运行任务和管理完成结果。多批次串行转换，JPEG 编码移至工作 isolate，减少界面阻塞（#75）。
- Linux x64／ARM64 在原有分发格式之外新增 RPM 和 AppImage；AppImage 随包提供 GTK 3、WebKitGTK 4.1、相关依赖、WebKit 子进程与沙箱辅助程序、图片加载器和字体配置，无需另外安装 GTK／WebKit。

### 修复

- 已下载漫画按稳定章节 ID 读取图片，避免源章节顺序变化后访问错误目录；目录缺失或为空时尝试在线恢复并提示，纯本地漫画提供恢复文件指引，保留本地记录和路径诊断日志。画廊与瀑布流共用加载逻辑，启动时等待存储路径校验完成（#76）。
- PDF 转换、入库与存储迁移、扫描恢复互斥，避免移动或删除正在写入的目录、提前扫描未完成漫画；迁移／恢复先开始时，PDF 等待其结束后继续，失败及取消均释放保护并清理未完成内容（#75）。
- 阅读进度条改为直接定位，修复连续阅读长章节快速跳页后无法触摸滚动的问题；导航与动画异常均正确释放触摸拦截。
- 自动阅读在完整读完长图后才跨章，瀑布流等待下一章加载完成后继续，末章停止后可重新启动；触摸、缩放、设置侧栏及应用进入后台时暂停，加载失败时停止，设置修改即时生效。阅读器 Overlay 随章节和模式更新，下一章加载失败后保留手动重试入口。
- 修复本地漫画版式识别错误处理 `file://` 路径的问题，单本模式设置值异常时安全回退；版式识别限制图片读取并发和总时长，退出时取消下载及后续采样。
- iOS 与宽屏侧栏返回手势统一从 24 像素边缘开始，修复中部滑动误返回、取消后仍返回及多指操作状态异常。收藏排序页与收藏夹共用列表／画廊模式、列数和卡片间距，保持拖拽排序及重启后的结果一致（#80）。
- 追更检查改为按源限流的并发队列，全局最多五本、同源最多两本，同源启动间隔至少 500 毫秒，单本最多等待 45 秒；取消、关闭进度框或新检查会终止旧队列、重试和关联请求，防止迟到结果修改收藏。
- 漫画源文件重试重新读取文件，重复导入可确认替换；编辑器保存后重新加载，外部编辑器启动失败时回退内置编辑器。解析或初始化失败保留原源，错误可查看和复制；调试器等待并格式化异步结果，修复可选配置解析和重复加载的函数引用泄漏。
- 漫画源更新取消时同时终止仓库查询及脚本下载，迟到响应不再修改已安装源；仓库无效条目会跳过并汇总提示，支持解除仓库关联，重复更新同一源时明确提示。
- 修复 AppImage 缺少 `libwebkit2gtk-4.1.so.0` 导致无法启动的问题，通过私有临时副本重定位 WebKit 硬编码路径，保留 WebKit 沙箱设置，并随包保存依赖版本和版权说明。

### 维护与文档

- 发布版本更新为 `1.17.0+228`，同步应用版本、发布配置与更新记录。
- 更新日志页面测试等待大文件的后台解码完成，避免完整日志超过 50 KB 后在测试时持续显示加载状态。
- 增加 Git 依赖审计清单与 CI 检查，覆盖直接及传递依赖的来源、完整 commit 和包路径；JS 引擎、图片缩放、连续滚动、WebView 及 WebDAV 切换至项目维护者的固定 commit fork，并记录维护责任、替换评估、回滚方式及

release.name: v4.55.0
release.notes:
## v4.55.0 — 2026-10-10

### Fixed

- **Android: a rendered frame no longer calls `onFrame` on every plain node of the scene ([#4451](https://github.com/sceneview/sceneview/issues/4451)).** `SceneView` and `ARSceneView` handed each frame to every root, and `Node.onFrame` recurses into every child: one virtual call, one time-step computation and one child iteration per node and per frame, for a tree where most nodes have nothing to do. Each scene now walks its tree once, keeps the calls that walk made — a smooth transform to advance, an `onFrame` callback or a library hook to invoke — in the order it made them, and replays that list until the tree or one of those slots changes. Measured on the Debug Overlay stress scene (1,064 nodes, debug build, emulator): 0.78 ms per frame before, 0.006 ms after. **The gain is for nodes whose class does not override `onFrame`** — shapes, lights, images, text, plain `Node`s. A node type that overrides it — `ModelNode`, `SplatNode`, or one of your own — is still called on every frame, in full, and still reaches its children through `super.onFrame`, exactly as before; since a `ModelNode` parents every node of its glTF, a scene made of models is walked as much as it was. Two visible differences, both for a change made from inside an `onFrame` callback: a callback set on another node, or a node attached, now gets its first tick on the next frame (it used to get it on the same frame only when that node happened to come later in the walk); and a sibling detached or destroyed by an earlier sibling's callback is no longer ticked one last time on that frame.
- **`ARSceneView` no longer leaves a refused camera unexplained (Android)** — a system dialog dismissed with Back was reported as a permanent denial and sent to system settings, although asking again would have worked; the built-in card now says "Grant camera access" for it and keeps "Open settings" for a dialog Android has really stopped showing. release.notes:
## 1.6.1 (CH)

发布的是 Pre-release 难道不就是，还需要一些测试吗，我自己没办法测试到所有的 case，这仅仅是一个免费开源的项目

希望大家都能友好反馈

在 Issue 中建议”撤销发布“，也许还有诸多人都有类似的想法

说难听点，这群不友好反馈的人，只是只会逼逼赖赖的伸手党而已，说那么多废话，自己有能力自己写一个我来用

但我就要发布！有问题好好反馈！我又不是不改！给你惯的！

- 优化 code-server 的拷贝逻辑，修复自定义版本失效的问题
- 修复 QEMU 相关的报错
- 优化 UI 样式，增加进度条信息展示，优化状态栏沉浸，修改了 App 图标
- 代码上的诸多优化，增加一些双语注释，优化进度条逻辑，不再使用`魔数`等
- 支持 I18n，目前支持中文和英语
- 升级 proot-distro 到 4.28.0
- 升级 code-server 到 4.103.1
- 升级 ubuntu 到 noble-aarch64-pd-v4.18.0

注意: 我打包的版本会收集以下信息
```json
{
    "app": "Code LFA",
    "time": "$TIME",
    "platform": "Android",
    "unique_key": "",
    "app_version": "",
}
```
其中 unique_key 是随机生成的，并非设备唯一 ID

这些信息仅仅用来观察我个人的软件的日活等，我需要根据这些数据来分配我的时间

如果你比较介意，后续我会同时带上不带数据上报的版本，或者自行编译

目前的接口是 HTTPS，后续我尝试用 HTTP 来上报，保证数据上的透明

这和垄断的 alist 上报数据并不一样，未涉及任何用户相关信息

很抱歉我个人有些强迫症，改了一些 git 的历史记录，fork 仓库的朋友需要执行以下代码或者重新 fork
预计近期还会改一些代码，等到正式发布 v1.6.0 的 Release 的时候，大家再操作
```bash
# 1) 备份当前分支（可选）
git branch backup/$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)

# 2) 添加/确认 upstream 指向你的仓库
git remote -v
git remote add upstream https://github.com/nightmare-space/code_lfa.git 2>/dev/null || true

# 3) 拉取最新（包含重写后的历史）
git fetch upstream --prune --tags

# 4) 切到要同步的分支（如 main），硬重置到 upstream
git checkout main
git reset --hard upstream/main

# 5) 强制推回自己的 fork（origin）
git push origin main --force-with-lease

# 若需要同步标签与清理已删除的标签
git push origin --tags --force --prune
```

## 1.6.1 (CH)

Isn’t a Pre-release meant for further testing? I can’t possibly cover every case myself; this is just a free, open-source project.

I hope everyone can provide feedback in a friendly manner.

Some people suggested “revoke the release” in Issues; perhaps many others feel the same.

To be blunt, those who don’t provide constructive feedback are just freeloaders who only complain. If you’re that capable, write something yourself for me to use.

But I’m going to release it anyway! If there are issues, provide proper feedback! It’s not like I won’t fix them!

repo.description: A libre Android browser built from scratch on Gecko. Privacy by default, powerful tab containers, and a local-first search engine.

release.name: v0.30.0
release.notes:
### GeckoView 155.0

This release brings together eleven updates since the last stable version. It gives you more control over when links open in other apps, adds website notifications without needing Google, makes bookmarks and the home screen far more customizable, and improves how WebLibre connects through Tor and proxies.

## Highlights

- **App Links** — decide when links open in other apps, with rules per site and per container
- **Website Notifications** — get notified by websites via UnifiedPush, without Google's involvement
- **Bookmarks Rewritten** — large bookmark collections load fast, and imports run smoothly in the background
- **Redesigned Home Page** — customize your sections, add a wallpaper, and choose where the search bar sits
- **Clearer Connections** — see at a glance how each tab is connecting, with more reliable Tor/proxy startup
- **Bangs Overhaul** — pin your favorite search shortcuts and use them right from the address bar
- **Customizable Browser Menu** — reorder or hide the menu items you don't use
- **Settings Export & Import** — copy your settings to another device in a few taps
- **Engine Upgrade** — GeckoView 155.0 for better compatibility and security

## App Links (New)

The web is full of links that could open in another app — a YouTube link opening the YouTube app, for example. WebLibre now lets you decide what happens when a page tries to do that.

- **Three modes** under Settings > Browsing > Open Links in Apps: **Ask before opening** (default), **Always**, and **Never**.
- **Remember your choice for a site** — tap "Remember for this site" in a prompt, and revisit or undo any saved choices later from a "Remembered site rules" list.
- **Per-site override** in a site's settings: always open in app, always keep in browser, or follow your default.
- **Advanced: per-container rules** — containers with their own cookies can have their own App Links setting and remembered sites, separate from the rest of the app.

release.name: sakuramedia v0.10.1
release.notes:
## 🎉 更新内容

### ✨ 新增
- 影片详情页全新改版：海报配整页模糊底座，标题、信息与操作压在封面下沿，打开更快；评分、上映日期、时长、厂商、导演等信息集中展示。
- 详情页操作区改为播放键加六个入口（订阅 / 播放列表 / 评论 / 磁力搜索 / 缩略图 / 更多），每个入口只弹一个功能面板。
- 播放页新增应用内全屏：全屏后右侧缩略图面板不再丢失；桌面端双击画面或点全屏按钮进入、Esc 退出。
- 新增「最近订阅」和「最近浏览」：概览页和移动端「我的」展示最近订阅的影片、最近看过的影片与女优，点「更多」查看完整列表；退订后会立即从最近订阅移除。
- 桌面侧边栏的版本信息改为单行显示，点开可查看客户端、服务端和插件的更新情况。
- 搜索入口从侧边栏移到顶栏，点击展开输入即可搜索；侧边栏收起后完全隐藏，不再保留图标窄条。
- 批量操作（批量删除媒体 / 切片 / 时刻 / 视频 / 下载任务，批量加入或移出合集）改由后台任务执行：一次最多提交 1000 项，提交后可以继续使用其它页面，进度和结果在活动中心查看，任务会显示「成功 X 项 · 失败 Y 项」，完成后刷新列表即可看到结果。
- Windows 窗口的无边框改为系统原生实现：拖动、缩放、贴边分屏、阴影和窗口动画恢复系统原生手感，同时去掉了会让拖动发卡的亚克力模糊底。

### ⚡ 优化
- 发现页和概览页的「最近添加」「最近订阅」「时刻」等预览从多行网格改为单行横向列表，桌面端悬停出现翻页箭头，首屏只加载要展示的数量。
- 图片地址变化时保留旧画面直到新图到达，不再闪回灰色占位。
- Windows 版播放页在视频与界面动画同时出现时的掉帧已修复。
- 屏蔽影片页滚到底自动加载，去掉了手动「加载更多」按钮。

### 🐛 修复
- 修复移动端冷启动或从通知直接进入时，未读通知和红点可能一直为空的问题。
- 修复重新进入影片详情页会先闪一下加载骨架的问题。
- 修复 4K / 8K 影片卡片上「可播放」标记重复显示的问题。

### ⚠️ 兼容性变化
- 需要后端 v0.10.0 及以上：批量操作、最近订阅、最近浏览依赖新版后端接口，后端版本过低时这些功能不可用。
- Android 安装包只提供 64 位 ARM 版本，体积从约 115 MB 降到约 40 MB；仅支持 32 位的旧设备无法安装。

### 💡 说明
- 影片卡片上的 ⓘ 快捷查看入口已移除，媒体与缩略图查看统一收进影片详情页的操作列。
- macOS 窗口左上角的红黄绿按钮改为应用自绘，与侧边栏的展开按钮排在同一行。

# v6.0.4 更新说明

## 如何更新

Android 直接安装 APK 覆盖升级，设置和数据不会丢失。
如需全新安装，请先卸载旧版再安装。

## 本次更新

**1. 频道列表全新改版：栏目、频道两级浏览**

频道面板改为左右两栏：左边是栏目列表，右边是当前栏目下的频道
（带频道号）。遥控器左右键在两栏间移动，跨一个大栏目只需几下方向键；
上下键在频道间找台。之前跨一个栏目要把中间频道的几十个台逐个滚过去，
现在方便多了。

顺带的小改进：多备用源的频道，面板里的「源」可以直接选定想用的那条，
不用再一条条轮换；收藏的频道也从左栏第一项进入。

**2. 换台更快**

遇到播不出来的频道源（比如源临时故障），现在能更快识别并自动换到
下一个备用源，等待转圈的时间明显缩短。

**3. 列表更新更可靠**

修复了在设置中更改参数或订阅后，某些情况下频道列表没有跟着更新的问题；
列表更新失败时也会给出提示，不再无声无息。正在看的频道如果不在新列表里，
会自动落到相近的频道，不会出现换台错乱。

## Command-line tools (qaul-cli, qauld & qauld-ctl)

The Command-line tools can be used to run qaul from the terminal. For example on an embedded computer without a screen such as a Raspberry Pi or on a Server in the internet.

**qaul-cli** is the interactive qaul CLI client for communicating over the qaul net via the terminal.

**qauld** is the qaul daemon to be run in the background and work as a _Community Node_ in the network.

**qauld-ctl** is the control client for the qauld daemon. It connects to a running daemon to inspect and configure it, from single commands, an interactive shell or a terminal UI.

release.name: v26.10.2
release.notes:
### More routing options and Android automation

- **Fragment routing:** Optional TLS ClientHello fragmentation in Smart Routing and ordinary Custom Routing, off by default. Advanced Custom Routing can supply its own Fragment outbound and parameters.
- **LAN proxy sharing:** An optional HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy for other devices on a trusted network, with a configurable port. It is off by default, has no authentication, and applies when VPN is next started from OneXray. Complete Raw JSON keeps control of its own inbounds.
- **Android automation:** Allow trusted tools such as Tasker or Automate to start and stop VPN through token-protected broadcasts. The feature is off by default and reuses the last configuration generated by an in-app connection.
- **Windows VPN integration:** Updated Microsoft Store system-VPN integration to Vole, refined runtime cleanup and packaging, and corrected the oversized X in Start-menu and pinned MSIX icons. EXE/ZIP continue to use Xray native TUN.
- **Configuration and connection handling:** Updated Xray configuration compatibility, simplified import/save validation, and improved startup failure handling and cleanup.

Changes are based on v26.9.5 through v26.10.2. Existing connections and settings can be retained when updating; the new Fragment, LAN sharing and Android automation switches remain off until enabled.

LAN sharing follows the selected routing rules and is available only while its VPN runtime is running. Saving a sharing change does not change an existing listener; start VPN from the app to apply it. Widgets, tiles, automation and Apple on-demand starts reuse the last generated configuration. Apple does not support hosting proxy listeners in Packet Tunnel Providers; LAN sharing is not advertised as a supported Apple background-proxy service.

OneXray remains a bring-your-own-server client with no account, ads, or app analytics.

release.name: Yuzic 2.17.0
release.notes:
### **Version 2.17.0**

TestFlight build **138** · Play version code **159**

#### Buttons that work both ways
- **A headphone or car button unpauses again.** Pressing an AirPod stem paused the music and then did nothing at all — every press after it was read as another pause. Yuzic asked the system which state it was in, and that is a question the system is not obliged to answer truthfully; it goes by what it last said itself now

#### Crossfade
- **Album segues stay hard-cut.** With crossfade on, a record mastered to run straight from one track into the next was faded through its own join — the overlap doubled, and the seam it was covering sounded worse than it does bare. Turning "Fade through segues" off has always promised this and never delivered it: the engine implemented it and waited on a flag the app never set
- **A crossfaded track counts as fully listened to.** The fade-out is time you can still hear the song, and it was not being counted, so tracks at the boundary quietly fell short of the scrobble threshold. Measured at four seconds lost on an eight-second crossfade, on both platforms

#### Settings that only offer what your server can do
- **Loudness normalisation appears where your server measures loudness.** It was offered to everyone while only Navidrome reports the figure it needs — on Jellyfin, Emby, Plex and local files the switch corrected against nothing
- **Streaming quality appears where the stream obeys it.** Plex plays the file it is pointed at and takes no quality request, and a local file has nothing to transcode, so on both of them setting cellular quality to Low still pulled the original

#### Your library
- **Jellyfin and Emby: an artist's top songs,** ranked by what you have played. The section was built for it and only ever appeared on Subsonic servers; the adapter contract had promised the fallback since it was written
- **Playlists are found when search asks your server.** Switching Search from this device to your server quietly dr

release.name: v2.8.1
release.notes:
# Changelogs - v2.8.1

### ✨ *New Features & Enhancements*

#### 🧩 Stremio Add-ons & Nuvio (thanks to [Skywave22](https://github.com/Skywave22))
- **Official-style Quick Install and a working Discover tab** – Quick Install lists the two official add-ons (Cinemeta and OpenSubtitles v3). Discover gains search, pull-to-refresh and a retry state, skips broken entries, folds duplicates, and sends add-ons that need configuring to their setup page.
- **Faster link fetching** – Every stream add-on is asked in parallel, each within its own time budget, so one slow or dead add-on no longer holds up the rest, and slow scraping add-ons such as the CNCVerse bridge get long enough to answer.
- **Add-on health badges** – The Manage tab shows whether each installed add-on is working and how fast it answers.
- **Search and provider chips** – Filter the Stremio sources sheet by add-on, provider, quality or label, and search your installed add-ons.
- **Clearer stream rows** – Rows read "Add-on · Provider", with the resolution always shown.
- **Nuvio link fixes** – Embedded stream objects, file names with spaces, `#` or `+`, and scraper ids with special characters no longer break link fetching.

#### 🎬 Player & Playback
- **Smoother seeking** – Quick repeated seeks (arrow keys, D-pad, gamepad shoulder buttons, double-taps) are merged: the first goes at once and the final position follows the moment you stop, instead of a full rebuffer for every press.
- **The seek bar follows your seek at once** – The scrubber and the clock move to where you sent playback straight away, instead of waiting for the stream to get there.
- **Clearer source status** – Sources that are not a video, or that cannot seek, are labelled in the Sources list, and resuming prefers a source that can seek.
- **Half the memory for the network buffer** – libVLC's read-ahead buffer was being allocated twice; the buffer size you choose is now the memory it uses.

#### 💬 Subtitles
- **Subtitle search in the player panel**

# L×Box v2.25.13 **A patch on top of [v2.25.12](https://github.com/Leadaxe/LxBox/releases/tag/v2.25.12).** The VPN can announce a system HTTP proxy to Android 10+, so Chrome and Play go through the core over TCP. The Unknown traffic preset is on for new installs and sends ownerless traffic direct. Merge on backup import now really merges. Speed Test measures Upload only where the server accepts it and shows the route the core used. A config over 1 MB can be replaced from a file. Setting hints, the Statistics hint and JSON views match the app. The user guide is rewritten in both languages. Core `v1.14.3-lx.15` and contract 1.1.115 are unchanged. **Патч поверх [v2.25.12](https://github.com/Leadaxe/LxBox/releases/tag/v2.25.12).** VPN умеет объявить Android 10+ системный HTTP-прокси: Chrome и Play идут через ядро по TCP. Пресет Unknown traffic на новой установке включён и отправляет бесхозный трафик напрямую. Merge при импорте бэкапа теперь действительно сливает. Speed Test меряет Upload только там, где сервер его принимает, и показывает маршрут, который выбрало ядро. Конфиг больше 1 МБ можно заменить из файла. Подсказки настроек, подсказка в Statistics и просмотр JSON приведены к приложению. Руководство пользователя переписано на обоих языках. Ядро `v1.14.3-lx.15` и контракт 1.1.115 без изменений. ---

🇬🇧 English

 ## ⚠️ Read before updating - **Unknown traffic with Reject switches to Direct.** If the preset was on with outbound `reject`, it now uses the new default `direct-out`: ownerless traffic leaves past the tunnel instead of being dropped. Reject was the default before, and the default is not saved with the rule, so the rule follows the new one. To keep it strict, pick Reject in the preset's outbound again after updating. release.name: NitroSQLite 10.2.0
release.notes:
NitroSQLite 10.2.0 improves repeated queries, async result delivery, and Android writes. It also adds runtime error constants and an errors-only entry point for shared code and Node.js tests. This minor release includes compatibility changes to SQL validation and query result objects, so review the upgrade notes before rebuilding your app.

## Performance improvements

Each connection now caches its 32 most recently used query and data-change statements. Repeated calls to `execute()` and `executeAsync()` can reuse compiled SQL when the query text stays the same. Bind values as parameters to benefit from this cache. Statements such as `PRAGMA`, `ATTACH`, and transaction commands still compile on every call. See the [performance guide](https://sqlite.margelo.com/docs/guides/performance).

Async queries, batches, and file imports now run on a dedicated worker thread per connection. Large managed async queries convert rows to JavaScript in batches while SQLite reads the remaining rows. The promise still resolves once with every row in order; paginate large queries to limit the final result size.

Android builds now use `fdatasync()` and enable batch atomic writes on supported F2FS filesystems. These changes reduce commit I/O without lowering `PRAGMA synchronous`. SQLite falls back to its rollback journal when atomic writes are unavailable. See the [Android configuration guide](https://sqlite.margelo.com/docs/configuration/android) for details and build-time opt-outs. [#440](https://github.com/margelo/react-native-nitro-sqlite/pull/440)

## Breaking changes and migration

### One SQL statement per query

SQL strings containing more than one statement now throw or reject instead of running the first statement and silently ignoring the rest. This affects `execute()`, `executeAsync()`, `prepare()`, each batch command, and each nonempty SQL-file line. Trailing whitespace, comments, and extra semicolons remain allowed. release.name: v5.1.3
release.notes:
## What's changed

### Fixes

- No more Reanimated 4.6 `dependencies should only be used in web implementation` warnings: hook dependency arrays are now passed on web only, where older Reanimated versions still need them.
- `ImageBackground` (deprecated in React Native 0.87) replaced with a `View` and an absolutely positioned `Image` in Panel2, Panel3, HueCircular and Preview.
- Input widgets no longer read shared values during render (Reanimated strict-mode warning) and no longer remount their inputs on every render.
- `ColorPickerRef.setColor` accepts every supported color format, not only strings.
- Panel2 and OpacitySlider animated styles declare the right dependencies.
- ExtraThumb worklets always call the latest `onChange` / `onComplete` callbacks, and negative hue transforms wrap around 360.
- Web keyboard handlers use the latest callbacks.
- LuminanceCircular normalizes the gesture angle after `rotate` is applied.
- Preview formats its initial color from the `value` prop.
- Panel2 accessibility label, and percentage spin scaling by hue.
- colorKit: decimal percentages are kept when parsing color strings; negative `spin` wraps below 0; manipulation methods are covered by tests.
- Deprecated `addWhitelistedNativeProps` call is guarded (no-op on Reanimated 4, still needed on Reanimated 3).

### Examples and docs

- ExampleLatest upgraded to React Native 0.87.1, ExampleExpoLatest to Expo SDK 57, ExampleOldArch builds with Xcode 26.
- The React Native examples run in the browser on the documentation site, and the docs are also published as markdown for LLMs.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/alabsi91/reanimated-color-picker/compare/v5.1.2...v5.1.3

release.name: Remote Pi Cockpit 2.1.15
release.notes:
**Four agent skills instead of one, installed on every machine (including
remote hosts), and a design kit for `.panel` dashboards.** Pair with
cockpit-server 2.1.15 so hosts get the skills too.
### Added
- **Skills split by purpose**: `cockpit-cli` (tabs, tasks, exec),
  `cockpit-db` (SQL, Redis, Mongo, connections), `cockpit-telemetry` (the
  error store) and `cockpit-design` (files the human reads: `.panel`, `.html`,
  `.kanban`, `.notebook`, `.ckp`, `.http`, `.dbq`). Each is short, with
  references read on demand, so the right one triggers for the right task.
- **Skills everywhere**: `cockpit install-skill` installs all four into every
  harness found on the machine (Claude Code, Codex, Pi), keeps a manifest per
  skill (updates and removals are exact, your own files are left alone), and
  the remote `cockpit-server` installs them on the host at boot.
- **`cockpit panel new --template dashboard|list-detail|form <file>`**:
  scaffolds a working `.panel` from a bundled template and opens it.
- **`cockpit panel screenshot [<tab|file>] [--out x.png]`**: a PNG of an open
  `.panel`, so an agent can look at what it built and iterate.
- **`cockpit.css` page anatomy**: `.page`, `.toolbar`, `.kpis`, `.split`,
  `.empty`, `.skeleton`, `.status-dot`, `.kv`, responsive in narrow panes.
  The Gallery's "panel" template is now a real dashboard.

---

é baixar os 3 arquivos desta release e colocar em

release.notes:
# Patch Notes v0.2.0

Big update.  Below are slightly technical bullet points if you don't want to read this entire text. Reworked the cloud sync to prevent save files being overwritten with a new save. Now it uses progress-based checks instead of timestamp-based checks if auto-sync is on. Also added manual push/pull from cloud if you want to leave the auto sync off. 

Automatic save backups can now be turned on for both cloud and local saves, and are stored in an external folder (storage/emulated/0/StS2Launcher/Saves/). This does require external storage permissions but it is NOT necessary if you don't care about save backups. If you do want to enable save backups, tap on one of the push/pull buttons and it will ask you for read/write permissions.

Mod compatibility is also included in this release. Currently only works for v0.98.x of the game. StS2 v0.99.x removes the requirement of a .pck file so it may be necessary to update this again when v0.99.0 drops publicly. If you'd like to test out mods, place them in the storage/emulated/0/StS2Launcher/Mods/ folder that gets created after enabling storage permissions indicated above.

The Steam session has been reworked. Instead of a persistent connection at launch, it now uses an on-demand connection in case the user backgrounds the app or the network drops. Validation of game ownership has been changed from every 30 days to now only required once at first download. I removed the requirement for every 30 days since it seemed a bit excessive - I was trying to prevent people from buying the game and refunding it within 2 hours. It's less of a headache to do a single validation for game ownership in case a user wants to stay offline after the first check. Finally, game files are now hash validated in case of corruption and will reattempt the download.

# v1.0.0-alpha.6

> [!WARNING]
> armeabi-v7a is not supported in this release. Support is planned for the next release.

> [!NOTE]
> ACSIDE (ACS Lite) now uses Termux Packages for the terminal backend and no longer uses PRoot by default. PRoot is not completely removed and can still be installed via PRoot-Distro.
>
> This change was made because Android's Bionic performs significantly faster than PRoot's glibc layer, without the overhead PRoot introduces. Performance after migrating to Termux Packages has been noticeably better.

## Highlights

- **Windows 11 Fluent 2 Look** – New optional visual style with smooth animations, transitions, and press feedback. Enable it in General Settings.
- **XML Layout Real Preview** – See your layouts rendered directly in the IDE, as a static image or a short video, without leaving the editor.
- **Compose Preview** – See your Compose previews directly inside the IDE, with adjustable size and density.

- **WebView 缓存真正可复用**：新增自带的小资源服务器取代插件默认实现，入口资源常驻内存、响应带 `immutable` 缓存头，并按应用版本编址。此前每次打开文档都会清空整个 WebView 缓存、重新读取并重新编译这 4.66MB 资源。
- **冷启动即预热编辑器**：首页画完后用离屏 WebView 把编辑器完整启动一遍，把引擎初始化、缓存落盘、首次建实例的成本从"打开文档"挪到"打开软件"；真正开始打开文档时自动让位，低端机不会同时存在两个实例。
- **预览 ⇄ 编辑 来回切换不再重启编辑器**：此前每次切换都会把预览面板（Android 平台视图）整个卸载再重建，等于重新加载并求值一遍整个编辑器（实测热态 ~440ms、冷态 ~1.4s）。现在两个面板常驻，只切换可见性。
- 就绪检测由 100ms 步长轮询改为页面主动通知；正式版移除多余的诊断通信；大文档下发体积近乎减半。

### 🐞 修复

- **修复打开/关闭文档的"卡顿感"**：实测这不是掉帧（帧率统计 95 分位 19ms、jank 0%），而是**过渡期间整页没有内容** —— 液态玻璃下加载骨架屏底色是透明的，路由淡入时能透过编辑器看到上一页，内容再在几百毫秒后凭空出现。现改为实色占位页、遮罩淡出而非硬切、去掉预加载时额外叠的一层转圈；按返回时也不再立刻抽掉内容，改为退场动画播完后再销毁。

### 🔭 后续

- 继续压"打开文档"的每文档成本：实测约 900ms 花在编辑器建实例与渲染上，其中代码块（CodeMirror）占大头，下一版尝试延迟创建。

## 一句话
本版三线并进：**易经 64 卦新增传统卦象典故插画**、**「中医时辰开穴综合计算器」扩为四法并排（纳子 / 纳甲 / 灵龟八法 / 飞腾八法）**、**五运六气新增三张可视化图并入库《内经》运气文献**。

---

## 🌟 一、易经 64 卦 · 卦象典故插画

- 每卦详情页在卦名（上卦／下卦说明）下方显示该卦的传统典故版画（如 **乾为天 = 云中取鹿**、**地天泰 = 梯上取鹿**），共 **64 张，全覆盖**。
- 插画文件名与 `yijing_data.dart` 的卦名**一一对应**（双向对账 64/64，无缺无多）；异体字归一（**天山遯 → 天山遁**）。
- `errorBuilder` 兜底：某图缺失时**静默收起**，不影响页面其它内容。
- 零新增依赖，包体积仅增约 **1.1 MB**。

## 🌟 二、中医时辰开穴综合计算器 · 四法并排

- 纳子法 / 纳甲法 / 灵龟八法 / 飞腾八法四个 Tab，选中即给出当日 **日干支、时干支** 与开穴。
  - **纳甲正开**：如 太渊（肺经 · 输穴），并给出「返本还原」原穴（输穴返本还原取原穴·神门）。
  - **飞腾八法**：按时干直接查卦取单穴（如时干辛 → 后溪）。
  - **灵龟八法**：日干支与时干支基数相加，阳日 +9 / 阴日 +6 取余数定卦穴（主穴 **照海** + 配穴 **列缺**），并列出推算步骤。
- 附天干歌 / 地支歌（天干 → 脏腑、时辰 → 经络）与各法说明，口径与参考站逐项对拍一致（198 日 × 12 时辰 = 19008 项零差异）。

## 🌟 三、五运六气 · 三张可视化图 + 文献入库

- 新增三图（Tab 切换，随所选日期重绘、当前步高亮）：
  - **运气五行图** —— 十字五宫夹中央，司天／在泉与五行圆形联动。
  - **五运图** —— 单环十扇区，主运／客运分色，标出各步界日期（大寒 / 春分 / 芒种 / 处暑 / 立冬系）。
  - **六气图** —— 双环，主气与客气逐步对应。
- 日期可任选（如生日），结果含：岁运（中运）病候、司天／在泉病候、运年干支与六十甲子序号、客气加临。
- **文献数据入库**：新增《内经》运气七篇大论原文（60 条）、三纪／太过不及／胜复郁（15 条）、六气胜复（6 条）、司天在泉病候 + 治则（12 条），App 内可直接查阅原文与治则。
- 零新增依赖；算法口径未改（与既有对拍夹具一致）。

---

* **Extended Media Info:** Added richer metadata and technical details to the Info page for images and audio files.

### Automation & Background Operations
* **Multi-String Pattern Matching:** `pattern` and `exclude_pattern` fields now accept comma-separated strings (e.g. `*.log, *.tmp`), allowing multi-rule matching in a single field.
* **Improved Background Keep-Alive:** Implemented more aggressive keep-alive handling with user prompts to prevent Android from killing automation operations mid-run.

release.notes:
<!-- ZenFile v3.5.6 更新日志（中英双语）。本注释在 GitHub 上自动隐藏。 -->

## ZenFile v3.5.6 (2026-10-13)

🐛 问题修复
· 修复分类页的「幽灵条目」：音频、下载、文档、压缩包、安装包里会列出 0 字节、或实际已经不存在的文件 —— 点「打开所在位置」跳过去却找不到该文件，在列表里删掉后一刷新它又回来了。根因是分类列表有 5 条数据入口绕过了「文件是否真实存在 / 是否为 0 字节」的校验（系统媒体索引读出了大小却没拿它过滤、磁盘缓存恢复完全信任旧路径、与旧列表合并时把空条目原样保留），现在统一在后台一次性核对并剔除，删掉的条目也不会再从缓存被带回来
· 修复分类卡片与快捷入口显示的数量多于列表实际条数（卡片上写着 12、点进去只有 8）的问题：数量的统计口径与列表统一为「过滤后的条数」
· 修复浏览页把 RMVB 显示成「未知格式」（同一个文件在分类页却能正常识别播放）：补齐浏览页的视频后缀（WMV / 3GP / M4V / RMVB / RM / ASF / F4V）、音频后缀（AMR / MID / MIDI）与图片后缀（ICO / RAW），与分类页对齐

🎨 界面与交互
· 设置—语言里的「自动（跟随系统）」改为跟随应用语言显示，此前在英文等界面下固定显示为中文
· 压缩 / 解压、复制 / 粘贴等进度弹窗的文案不再带黄色下划线（此前每行文字下方都有一条黄线）
· 进度弹窗的水平分隔线不再超出圆形进度环、也不再与进度环或「后台 / 取消」按钮重叠：分隔线宽度按圆环内缘重新对齐（圆周直径 300、内圈环内缘距圆边 17px，分隔线取 260px、两端各留 20px，贴住内缘但不压环）

---

## ZenFile v3.5.6 (2026-10-13)

🐛 Bug Fixes
· Fixed the "ghost entries" in the category pages: Audio, Downloads, Documents, Archives and Packages used to list files that are 0 bytes or no longer exist on disk - tapping "Open containing folder" jumped to a folder that does not contain the file, and deleting such an entry brought it right back after a refresh. The category lists had five data paths that bypassed the "does the file really exist / is it 0 bytes" check (the system media index read the size but never filtered by it, the on-disk cache restore trusted the old paths as-is, and merging with the previous list kept the empty entries unchanged); they are now all verified once in the background and dropped, and deleted entries are no longer restored from the cache
· Fixed category cards and shortcut tiles showing a higher count than the list actually contains (the card said 12 while only 8 were listed): the count now uses the same filtered result as the list
· Fixed the file browser showing RMVB as "Unknown format" while the same file was recognised and played fine from the category pages: the browser now knows the video extensions (WMV / 3GP / M4V / RMVB / RM / ASF / F4V), audio extensions (AMR / MID / MIDI) and image extensions

repo.description: 番茄内容聚合 Android 客户端：小说/短剧/漫剧/听书/漫画，Flutter UI + 进程内 Rust 核心，无自建服务器、无需 root

release.name: fqapp 1.0.96 — 短剧清晰度恢复 1080P
release.notes:
## fqapp 1.0.96 — 短剧清晰度恢复 1080P

Android 手机本地运行的番茄内容聚合客户端：小说阅读、短剧与漫剧播放、听书、漫画、搜索、历史与离线缓存，全部在同一个 App 内完成。

核心（签名、解密、缓存）全部在手机上运行，**不需要自建服务器，不需要 root**。

> ⚠️ 本项目仅供学习与研究交流，不内置、不分发任何内容资源；在线内容均来自番茄公开接口，版权归字节跳动及原权利方所有。本项目与番茄/字节跳动无关联，未获其授权。

---

## 本版变化（1.0.89 → 1.0.96）

### 🎬 短剧清晰度恢复 1080P

短剧播放页与 feed 长按面板的清晰度列表此前最高只有 720P，现已恢复 1080P。

原因不在客户端封顶，而在取流路径：同一集内容上游有两条接口，短剧专用接口的档位表到 720P 为止，1080P 只出现在另一条接口返回的备用播放信息里；而客户端在主列表非空时就直接返回了，从未去看那份备用信息。修复过程中还发现一个解析缺陷会让备用信息里的播放地址解不出来，一并修掉。

- 面板现在会列出全部可选档位（360P / 480P / 540P / 720P / 1080P，视该剧上游实际提供而定）
- **默认档位不变**（仍是自动选中的最高档）；想要 1080P 请在面板里显式选择
- 编码门保持原样：设备解不了的编码档位不会被放出来，宁可少一档也不给一个放不出来的流

### 🎧 听书 / 听视频：通知升级为真正的媒体通知（#4 / #5）

- 折叠态直接显示「上一章 / 播放暂停 / 下一章」三个按钮，不用手动展开
- 进入系统媒体卡片（快捷设置媒体区）、锁屏媒体控制；耳机线控与蓝牙按键正常路由
- 显示真实进度与时长
- 补了显式的「关闭」动作

### 📖 离线：无网时也能续读（#3）

- 无网时在书架点已下载的书直接进阅读器
- 详情页在加载中或失败时，只要能查到本地整本缓存，就给出「从缓存阅读」入口
- 书架为空时补了「查看离线缓存」入口（书架空 ≠ 本地没内容）

### 🎬 短剧 feed 长按面板补齐官方行集

对齐官方客户端，补齐：清晰度、清屏播放、离线缓存、听视频、弹幕开关、字体大小。

### 🔧 其它

- 播放器加载诊断与原生 Range 处理加固
- 下载与请求处理加固

---

## 功能一览

| 功能 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 📖 小说阅读 | 图文正文与插图、左右分页或上下滚动、排版与字体导入、亮度调节、段评、离线缓存 |
| 🎬 短剧 / 漫剧 | 自动连播、**清晰度切换（最高 1080P）**、倍速、上下集与快进快退、全屏方向自适应、进度续看、弹幕 |
| 🖼 漫画 | 竖向连续阅读、章节目录、单图重试、点击放大、阅读位置恢复 |
| 🎧 听书 | 智能朗读与真人讲书、边听边读字幕、关联作品、定时关闭、倍速、自动下一章、进度续听、**系统媒体通知** |
| 🔍 搜索与发现 | 关键词 / 作品 ID 搜索、联想词与热搜、排行榜、作者主页、书评 |
| 📋 详情 | 封面、分类、完结状态、字数、评分、标签、简介、目录预览、书评、关联作品 |
| 🕘 历史与书架 | 阅读 / 播放进度自动记录，续读续看；离线缓存管理 |
| ⬇️ 下载 | 整本缓存、批量缓存后续章节；另支持把整本书导出为一份 TXT 到系统「下载」 |

---

## 下载与安装

### 设备要求

- **Android 7.0（API 24）及以上**，**arm64-v8a** 设备（近几年绝大多数手机）
- 需要网络：在线内容实时从上游获取，App 本身不内置任何内容
- 不需要 root

### 安装

1. 下载下方 `fqapp-1.0.96-arm64.apk`
2. 点击安装（或 `adb install fqapp-1.0.96-arm64.apk`）
3. 首次启动保持联网：App 会自动完成初始化 → 启动本地核心并注册设备 → 健康检查通过后进入主界面

> ⚠️ **签名与升级**：正式签名包与调试签名包**不能互相覆盖安装**。若你装过旧的调试签名版本（`v1.0.17` 及更早），升级需**先卸载**再安装，卸载会清除阅读历史与缓存。**同签名版本可直接覆盖升级**（本版与 `v1.0.88` 同为正式签名，直接覆盖即可）。

## Custom RR v1.3.6

This release makes device detection smarter and lets happy users rate the app
at the right moment.

### Added

- **Better-timed "rate the app" ask on Google Play.** After the app has
  actually helped you (a couple of ROM or recovery downloads opened), the Play
  version now asks for a quick rating in a small bottom sheet, at most once a
  week, and never again once you rate or decline. A "Rate the app" shortcut
  also joined the app menu.

### Fixed

- **Device detection matches many more phones.** The "your device" card now
  recognizes vendor-prefixed codenames (an Infinix Note 30 reporting
  `Infinix-X6833B`), regional variants (a realme 7 reporting `rmx2151l1`),
  stock OnePlus names (`OnePlus6T` finds fajita), and unified family builds
  (a Redmi 8 reporting `olive` finds the shared `mi439` builds), instead of
  telling you the phone is not in the catalog.

See the full diff and commit log via the **Full Changelog** link below.

---

### iOS - unsigned IPA (for AltStore / TrollStore users)

The iOS `.ipa` asset is **not** signed by an Apple Developer account, so
it will **not** install like a normal app. It is for sideloading with
tools such as [AltStore](https://altstore.io) or TrollStore, which
re-sign it with your own certificate at install time. If you do not use
one of those, ignore this file and grab the Android or desktop builds
above.

- **Copying a world** — copying a world moved its cards and sessions to the copy and left the original empty. This is fixed. The copy now also takes the world's images, PDFs, attachments and package links, and links inside text point to the copy's own cards.

release.name: v3.5.0
release.notes:
## 📋 What's Changed

### Breaking Changes

- **Global size reaches every control:** `FlowerySizeManager` now tracks every loaded control that declares a `StyledProperty<DaisySize>` named `SizeProperty` and supplies the current tier to it. Previously only a handful of controls subscribed. Controls that were sized by the one-shot visual-tree walk, or not at all, now follow `ApplySize()` as well. A `Size` set in XAML, code, a style or a binding is never overwritten; use `IgnoreGlobalSize` to opt a subtree out.
- **`FlowerySizeManager.CurrentSize` defaults to `Medium`** (was `Small`) so that applications which never call `ApplySize()` keep the class defaults. `Reset()` resets to `Medium`. Applications that relied on the implicit `Small` default must call `ApplySize(DaisySize.Small)` on startup.
- **Visual-tree propagation no longer creates local values:** the walk uses `SetCurrentValue` and skips controls with a base value. Code that relied on `IsSet(SizeProperty)` being `true` after propagation must use `GetBaseValue` instead. Plain CLR `Size` properties without a `StyledProperty` are no longer propagated.
- **One font-size ladder:** the `DaisySize*FontSize` tokens are now 10/12/14/18/20 (were 8/10/12/14/16) and mirror `FlowerySizeManager.GetFontSizeForTier`. `DaisyKbd*FontSize`, `DaisyMenu*FontSize` and `DaisyBadge*FontSize` use the same values; badge heights grew to 16/20/24/28/32. Every control that uses these tokens renders larger text at the same tier. Override the tokens in `Application.Resources` to restore the previous values.
- **`DaisyControlLifecycle` handles themes only:** the constructor parameters `getSize`, `setSize` and `subscribeSizeChanges` were removed. Update custom controls that used the helper for size changes; global size is supplied by the manager.
- **`DaisyGlobalSizeSubscription` was removed.** Its behaviour is now part of `FlowerySizeManager`.

- 下载引擎不再随界面销毁；连续下载与并发任务共享后台服务，避免任务交接时中断。
- 全部任务结束后自动释放后台服务与唤醒锁；补充取消、失败及系统后台时限的清理处理。
- 关闭普通下载通知不会关闭必要的后台运行保护。

## 验证

- Flutter 静态检查通过，106 项测试全部通过。
- Android 模拟器实测：切到桌面并锁屏后，分离的音视频仍完成下载和合并，生成的 MP4 包含视频和音频，历史记录正常保存。
- 确认任务结束后后台服务与唤醒锁均已释放，并验证界面销毁与重新打开时下载引擎的生命周期。

## 安装

- 一般 Android 手机选择 `app-arm64-v8a-release.apk`。
- 旧款 32 位 ARM 设备选择 `app-armeabi-v7a-release.apk`。
- x86_64 设备或模拟器选择 `app-x86_64-release.apk`。

本修复针对正常切后台和锁屏；不保证应用被系统强行终止后继续下载。部分厂商的额外省电限制仍需在真机上确认。

release.name: HeinPlay-1.4.0
release.notes:
## 更新内容
- **新增 Linux 电脑版（面向掌机）**：桌面端新增 Linux 版，产物为单文件 AppImage（`heinplay-1.4.0-linux-x86_64.AppImage`），免安装、双击即用，**重点服务 Steam Deck 等掌机 / 手持设备**，同时适用于普通桌面 Linux。配套一键安装脚本负责安装、升级与卸载；掌机场景下 SteamOS 游戏模式自动全屏铺满、播放页返回键可正常退出；应用文件名与安装路径全部使用英文，避免在用户目录生成中文路径。已在 ONEXPLAYER（Bazzite）掌机上完成实机验证。
- **新增游戏手柄操作支持**：Android TV、tvLegacy、Windows、Linux 全面支持游戏手柄 —— **A 键 = 确认、B 键 = 返回、十字键 = 方向键**，与遥控器 / 键盘 / 鼠标完全等效，所有界面（含弹窗、选集、换源）均可用手柄操作。
- **电脑版（Windows / Linux）统一交互**：Windows 与 Linux 统一为功能一致的「电脑版」，键鼠交互统一为 —— 鼠标悬停即高亮焦点、回车 = 左键 = 确认、ESC = 右键 = 返回，同一时刻只有一处焦点；顶部导航改为方向键逻辑移动（↓ 进入内容区、↑ 返回导航）；首页 / 分类页按 ESC 或右键弹出退出确认；设置中「Windows」分组更名为「电脑版」。
- **Windows 便携版存储与缓存重构**：偏好主表由约 7.5MB 降至约 39KB（大体积缓存值外置 + 写入去抖），启动维护降至十几毫秒，直播起播不再因重写偏好表卡顿；派生缓存迁至 `data/cache/` 并按「TTL + 7 天」滚动淘汰，海报缓存由 90 天调整为 7 天。同时修复便携版更新后需重新登录、历史日志丢失的问题。
- **点播源清晰度与排序优化**：源列表排序改为「可用性 > 清晰度 > 速度」，修正此前 360P 源因测速快而排在 1080P 之前的问题；去掉分辨率缓存兜底，避免解析失败时被旧缓存的低清晰度永久锁死。
- **直播体验优化**：直播不再套用点播缓冲档位（改用播放器低延迟默认值），起播与换台更快；频道列表与完整节目单打开时首帧即停在当前频道，不再有从顶部滚动跳转的动画；节目单找不到覆盖当前时间的节目时退化为「时间上最接近现在」的一条；EPG 缓存改为「仍覆盖当前时间」才复用，过期强制刷新。
- **tvLegacy 低版本安卓兼容性优化**：优化 tvLegacy 对低版本安卓设备（Android 5.0+）的兼容性，提升旧机型与旧安卓版本上的运行稳定性。
- **fvp 播放源兼容性提升**：修复部分播放源「能出画面但定格」（底层流参数探测窗口由 0.1 秒放宽至 0.5 秒）；关闭 fvp 低延迟模式 —— 其注入的 `fflags=+nobuffer` 会丢弃首个关键帧包，导致缓冲失效、进度条恒等于播放位置、拖动后不预取；底层播放器（libmdk / ffmpeg）日志已接入 App 日志（tag `MDK` / `FVP`），便于定位源兼容性问题。Windows / Linux / 鸿蒙 / tvLegacy 各 fvp 路径同步生效。
- **播放与交互修复**：修复电脑版关闭去广告后点播黑屏、Windows / Linux fvp「有声音无画面 / 卡死」、VLC 起播慢被误判为播放失败、开启去广告时切换播放器导致软件无响应、Windows 直播回放（catchup=append 类型源）无法回放、电脑版回车 / 小键盘回车无法确认、方向键焦点锁死与顶部导航 ↓ 进不了内容页等问题；修复 Android TV 与 tvLegacy 退出播放时闪退。
更新日志详见 CHANGELOG.md

release.name: Juicr v1.0.1
release.notes:
## Added

- GitHub Actions release automation now rebuilds Android and Android TV APKs from the repository.
- Android and Android TV releases now publish universal, `arm64-v8a`, `armeabi-v7a`, and `x86_64` APK downloads for the same `v1.0.1` release.
- The release changelog now separates mobile and TV work so the website can surface version notes cleanly.

## Changed

- Android release artifacts use stable `juicr-android` names, and Android TV release artifacts use matching `juicr-tv` names.
- Android TV is aligned to version `1.0.1` so both app lanes can be rebuilt and published together.
- The release workflow builds Android and TV in separate jobs before publishing the full asset set to the existing GitHub release.

## Fixed

- Android release APKs no longer force close during startup when release minification initializes background app services.
- Release publishing no longer stops at mobile-only artifacts when the current public release also expects TV downloads.
- Manual workflow runs can rebuild the current release from the checked-out repository instead of relying on local release assets.
- The release rebuild no longer risks timing out while producing both Android and TV assets.

## Recent work

- Rebuilt `v1.0.1` with signed Android and Android TV APKs produced by GitHub Actions.
- Organized the release into mobile and TV asset groups with matching ABI coverage.
- Updated repository and website release copy so download pages can point users at the current asset names.

## Contributors

- Team Juicr

repo.description: 1-Click LLM Server on Your Phone — no Termux needed! 无需Termux，一键让你的手机变成LLM服务器！

release.notes:
### 备注：
本次更新实际上实现了高通骁龙CPU的GPU（opencl）和NPU后端，但经过测试，opencl后端存在无限重复、高版本android设备上无法使用系统opencl库等问题，所以暂时禁用，目前CPU后端仍是llama.cpp最推荐使用的后端。
llama.cpp相关二进制文件已从git仓库移除，如需编译请使用release中的预编译包或自行编译。

### v1.2.2

新增
- llama.cpp 支持 Hexagon NPU（实验性），适用于骁龙 8 Gen 2 及以上。可在服务配置中选择该后端，并设置卸载层数（0–99）。
- 启动前会检测当前设备实际支持的 llama.cpp 后端。已保存的加速后端不可用时，自动改用 CPU。

优化
- llama.cpp 的默认生成线程数由 2 调整为 4。
- 内置 llama.cpp 运行时升级到 0.4.1。
- 模型库部分提示组件UI进行优化。

### Notes:
This update actually implements the GPU (OpenCL) and NPU backends for Qualcomm Snapdragon CPUs, but after testing, the OpenCL backend has issues such as infinite repetition and being unable to use the system OpenCL library on newer Android devices, so it is temporarily disabled. Currently, the CPU backend is still the most recommended backend for llama.cpp.
The llama.cpp-related binary files have been removed from the Git repository. If you need to compile, please use the precompiled packages in the release or compile them yourself.

New
- llama.cpp supports the Hexagon NPU (experimental) on Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 and later. The backend can be selected in service settings, with an offloaded layer count from 0 to 99.
- ServLlama checks which llama.cpp backends the device actually supports before starting. If the saved accelerator is unavailable, it falls back to CPU.

Improvements
- The default llama.cpp generation thread count is now 4, up from 2.
- The bundled llama.cpp runtime is updated to 0.4.1.
- Optimize the UI of the prompt component in the model library section.

## What's Changed
* Feature/llama cpp snapdragon backends by @ArkaneFans in https://github.com/ArkaneFans/servllama/pull/44


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ArkaneFans/servllama/compare/1.2.1...1.2.2

## Console 1.2.15

Console no longer needs the Mobile Bridge. It talks to Hermes' own Gateway and
Dashboard, and the new first run is: scan a code, confirm, you are on Home.

**What is new**

- A chat that shows Hermes' work in plain words, like Hermes Desktop, with an

- Voice conversations inside the chat; the on-device recogniser is ready when you
  tap.
- A Home board of sized widgets (Now, Chats, Bots, Rooms, Cron, Tasks) that

- A plain tap dock, one identity per profile, and a floating app pet.
- Models: edit the fallback chain and remove a provider completely.
- Calmer notifications and launcher widgets that stay current.
- A floating, translucent look in every theme, light and dark.

**Connecting**

Run one line on the computer where Hermes lives and scan the code it shows (see
the [README](https://github.com/xP3ta/hermes-console#connect)).
The current setup helper needs Console 1.2.15 or newer.

**Coming from a bridge-era install?** The app cleans up its side on the first
launch. When every phone is on 1.2.15, remove the bridge from the computer with
the helper's `--retire-bridge` line (Windows: `-RetireBridge`).

Full list of changes: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/xP3ta/hermes-console/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#1215-9540--2026-10-12).

**Installing:** Android 7.0 or newer. These APKs are the signed `full` release,
one per CPU architecture (most phones need `arm64-v8a`); verify the SHA-256 and
signing certificate before installing. Google Play and GitHub/Obtainium builds
are signed with different keys: stay on one channel.

release.name: Linthra v0.2.9
release.notes:
# Linthra v0.2.9

Linthra 0.2.9 is a stability and reliability release focused on making everyday playback, downloads, syncing, local libraries, Android, and Linux more predictable under failures, races, account changes, and disappearing resources.

There is deliberately no headline feature in this release. The work since 0.2.8 concentrated on making existing features hold up when operations overlap or something goes wrong.

## Highlights

### Playback is harder to knock off course

Playback now handles a much wider set of awkward timing and failure cases without getting stuck, showing the wrong state, or letting an older track leak into the one you selected.

Among the fixes:

- Play after Stop reloads the current track instead of reviving an older source or hanging on Loading.
- Pause, seek, Next, queue changes, session restore, repeat-one, and audio-focus changes keep the latest listener action authoritative while a track is loading.
- A failed or stalled remote stream has bounded recovery instead of silently remaining in a playing/loading state forever.
- Missing local files are reported as local-file problems rather than network failures.
- A failed track cannot silently replace the title/state of the track that is actually playing.
- Finished queues, restored queues, repeat-one loops, and replaying a recently played song behave consistently.
- Automatic skipping remains bounded and visible rather than silently running through the queue.

### Downloads and smart pre-cache

Downloads and automatic caching now agree more reliably about ownership, cancellation, network policy, and account identity.

- Cancelling a download stays cancelled even when smart pre-cache overlaps it.
- A server error page cannot be saved as if it were an audio download.
- Downloads held for Wi-Fi start once the network policy allows them, including on Linux.
- A pre-cached copy promoted to a real download is not immediately treated as the oldest cache entry.

# Flutify 0.13

正式版，应用版本为 `0.0.13+13`。本版主要修复 macOS 窗口拖动问题。

## macOS 窗口拖动修复

- 修复搜索框上半部分会误触发窗口拖动的问题（[#18](https://github.com/is-hp-is-mad/Flutify/issues/18)，[#19](https://github.com/is-hp-is-mad/Flutify/pull/19)）：原生层关闭窗口的隐式拖动（`isMovable = false`），改由 Flutter 顶栏显式提供拖动区。搜索框内拖选、双击选词、清除按钮不再移动或最大化窗口。
- 宽窗口登录页补上专用拖动区，按钮避让交通灯，正文区域不会拖动窗口。
- 顶栏空白处拖动、双击最大化/还原保持正常。

## 下载

- Windows x64 / ARM64：安装版 `*-setup.exe` 与便携版 `.zip`。
- Android：arm64-v8a、armeabi-v7a、x86_64 和通用 APK，沿用此前的固定签名，可直接覆盖安装。
- macOS 12.0 及以上：`Flutify-v0.13-macos.zip`，解压后将 `Flutify.app` 放入应用程序目录。未做 Developer ID 签名和 Apple 公证，首次打开可能需要在系统设置的“隐私与安全性”中允许打开。
- 校验和见 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。

## 已知问题

- macOS 关闭隐式拖窗后，屏幕边缘分屏/平铺、多显示器拔插后的窗口恢复，以及所有页面与覆盖层顶部的拖动尚未完成实机验收，遇到拖不动的区域欢迎反馈。
- 从 v0.09 或更早版本升级时，旧版 Windows 更新器可能仍会失败；请手动运行新版安装包。
- Windows 原生 Widevine 许可证 HTTP 403 问题仍未解决；x64 保留实验性原生路径及加载失败回退，ARM64 继续使用 WebView2。

* fix(macos): 禁用搜索框隐式拖窗并补齐登录页拖动 by @ClaudeByAnthropic in https://github.com/is-hp-is-mad/Flutify/pull/19

release.name: Pyre 1.2.3 — reliability + quality
release.notes:
**The reliability + quality release.** 1.2.3 is a big one — it folds in everything since 1.2.1: a security + data-safety pass, a wave of roleplay-quality fixes, real new features you asked for, and a top-to-bottom hardening of multi-device sync. Driven directly by your reports and a full-app audit. Thank you 🔥

## Multi-device sync is now solid
The headline. A deep audit found ways your edits could silently fail to reach your other devices — and we closed all of them:
- An edit made just after your clock drifted (or an NTP correction) could be stamped "in the past" and become **invisible to your other devices forever**. Fixed with a monotonic revision clock end-to-end.
- A record could get stuck "always dirty," re-sending every tick but never converging.
- The sync hub now reports the **honest outcome of every pushed item**, so a record that didn't land is retried instead of being mistaken for "delivered."
- **Data now hits the disk before the sync cursor moves** on both sides — a crash mid-sync can no longer leave you with a moved cursor and lost data.
- **API-key sync is atomic**: a key is written to secure storage before it's adopted, so a storage hiccup can never leave you with a key that vanishes on restart.

Every one of these was reviewed line-by-line before shipping.

## Security & your data
- Your **API key is no longer sent to a provider's new host** after you change its URL — it's cleared at Test, Browse, and Save until you re-enter it.
- A **factory reset now warns** before any image that can't be backed up would be lost.
- **Backups are more complete**: in-progress character drafts and your BotBooru avatar's uncropped original are included, image types (MIME) survive a restore, and a corrupt attachment is caught instead of silently breaking. Backups now carry an integrity checksum.

release.name: v0.5.2
release.notes:
## What's new in DreamPlayer 0.5.2


### Fixed

- **The fullscreen button did nothing (issue #45).** Tapping it left the
  orientation exactly as it was, on every file and with both engines. The
  button, its handler and the manifest were all correct — the bug was in which
  list was passed to `SystemChrome.setPreferredOrientations`. Flutter packs
  the requested orientations into a bitmask before handing them to
  `Activity.setRequestedOrientation()`: asking for *both* landscape
  orientations decodes to `SCREEN_ORIENTATION_USER_LANDSCAPE`, and asking for
  all four decodes to `SCREEN_ORIENTATION_FULL_USER`. Android honours those
  `USER*` constants only while rotation is **unlocked** — with the common
  rotation lock enabled, both halves of the toggle were silently ignored. The
  button now requests a single forced constant per direction
  (`SCREEN_ORIENTATION_LANDSCAPE` / `SCREEN_ORIENTATION_PORTRAIT`), which the
  platform does not defer to the rotation lock. Verified on-device with
  `accelerometer_rotation=0` — the condition the old code could never pass.
- **Opening a title with a VobSub (`.idx`/`.sub`) subtitle crash-killed the
  app (issue #44).** `SubtitleFormats.toUtf8()` ran on the platform thread
  during `open()` and read the **entire** sidecar with no size cap, then
  charset-detected it, built a String and re-encoded it — roughly 150-250 MB
  of transient allocation for one 19 MB bitmap subtitle. Bounded three ways
  now: a 64 KB sniff prefix, a 1 MB size cap, and binary content rejected
  outright. Two routing bugs fixed alongside — `.idx` was not recognised as a
  subtitle at all and fell through to SubRip, and `.sub` mapped
  *unconditionally* to MicroDVD, a **text** parser, while a VobSub `.sub` is
  raw MPEG-Program-Stream.
- **VobSub subtitles rendered at double size on 4K video (libmpv engine).**

## ProxySmith v2.4.0

### Download

| File | For |

- Bound subscription downloads, reject unsafe URLs, deduplicate links, and sample exact counts.

- Keep Android testing alive with a foreground data-sync service.
- Pass desktop subscription and test URLs over standard input instead of exposing them in process arguments.

## Highlights

This release fixes a crash that could prevent streak scheduling from resuming after a device reboot on existing Android installs.

## Bug fixes

- **BootReceiver crash on reboot** — Fixed `ClassCastException: Integer cannot be cast to Long` when reading saved schedule settings from SharedPreferences. Older app versions stored values like `interval_hours`, fixed schedule hour/minute, and retry counters as integers; newer code read them as longs, which crashed `BootReceiver` on boot and blocked alarm rescheduling.
- **Automatic migration** — On first read after updating, legacy integer values are converted to longs and rewritten so future reads are safe.

## Install

Download **StreakSaver-v2.1.4.apk** below, or use the stable link:

https://github.com/Jon2G/TiktokStreakSaver/releases/latest/download/StreakSaver.apk

## Full changelog

https://github.com/Jon2G/TiktokStreakSaver/compare/v2.1.3...v2.1.4
